authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.basis: R13/R14 TABLE insertion uses three BD scales, not the R2000+ BB scale selector; the BLOCK_HEADER is a hard pointer. The specification notes TABLE was introduced later, so R13/R14 custom-class profiles need individual source evidence.

source.provenance: ACadSharp sample script uses AutoCAD SAVEAS LT98; the exact producing build and original source provenance are unverified. The source is read in place and not committed.
source.peer: GNU LibreDWG dwgread 0.14 independently reports TABLE handles 0x528 and 0xA35, block headers 0x570 and 0xA36, insertions (774.865723661128, 48.53878603809859, 0) and (18.3905818828116, -140.70432957829854, 0), scales (1,1,1), rotation 0 and normal (0,0,1).

change: Decode a bounded R13/R14 insertion prefix with version-correct scales and hard-pointer BLOCK_HEADER. Mark all TABLE content incomplete, publish the existing 2D INSERT compatibility projection and retain an unvalidated raw source peer. Refuse unqualified legacy ATTRIB sequences. No complete cell semantics are claimed.

validation.source: Entity parse failures fall from two to zero for the hash-selected source; four other object failures and three unmodeled custom instances remain. Both TABLE typed prefixes and 2D projections match peer coordinates, scales and block handles; each has a nonempty, explicitly unvalidated raw peer.
validation.repeatableExternal: Set LIBDXFRW_AC1014_TABLE_SAMPLE to the source path and run CTest libdxfrw_table_legacy_external. Its wrapper rejects any different source hash. No external DWG or derivative is committed.
validation.generated: R13/R14 locally authored controls exercise distinct non-unit scales and 3D placement, block-handle roles and width, non-finite values, unqualified ATTRIB, truncation, reset and same-parser retry.
validation.compatibility: AC1021/AC1024 TABLE placement vector and five rebuilt prefix, callback order, proxy-graphics, fallback runtime-dispatch and TABLE content tests passed.
validation.publication: Strict and explicit partial ASCII/binary conversion of the sample refused at the separate IMAGEDEF owner gate and preserved destination bytes. This is not whole-file or native TABLE output qualification.
